results.title: Sudurpaschim crowned NPL champions after dominant final win
results.content: George Munsey’s spectacular century powers Sudurpaschim to a 10-wicket victory over Lumbini Lions in the final of the Nepal Premier League’s third season.

results.title: Road to the final: Powerplay could hold the key to NPL title
results.content: Statistics from the third edition of the Nepal Premier League suggest that teams making the most of the first six overs have a much better chance of winning.

results.title: Santoshi Shrestha wins two golds with course records in Maldives
results.content: The Nepali runner claimed the women’s half-marathon and 5km titles at the Dhiraagu Road Race 2026, while Santosh Bikram Bista finished just a second behind the men’s half-marathon winner.

results.title: Saroj Kumar Yadav appointed Madhesh chief minister
results.content: The JSP Nepal parliamentary party leader was appointed under Article 168(3) of the constitution after no coalition secured a claim to form the provincial government.

results.title: Nepali cinema can’t stop playing ‘blame the buhari’ game
results.content: A pattern in recent films casts women’s ambitions as threats to family harmony, reinforcing familiar stereotypes.

results.title: No Indian minister to attend India-Nepal business roundtable during Shah’s state visit
results.content: The absence of Indian ministerial representation at the November 22 roundtable comes as Prime Minister Balendra Shah seeks greater investment from Nepal’s southern neighbour during his state visit.

results.title: Nepal has failed disaster survivors before. Can Bhotekoshi be different?
results.content: Past relocation schemes have left families in unsafe settlements or driven them home. A 55-year-old settlement in Kanchanpur offers lessons as the government plans to relocate Bhotekoshi flood survivors.

results.title: Why a viral TikTok about ‘baddies’ has struck such a nerve in Nepal
results.content: When a TikToker declared Nepal’s young women an ‘epidemic’, they answered with stethoscopes, spreadsheets and sarcasm.

results.title: RSP joins local polls race as old parties move to guard their base
results.content: The party has opened its Candidate Club for aspiring candidates, while the Congress, the UML and the Nepali Communist Party seek to retain and expand their local electoral base.

results.title: Two ex-ministers among ten arrested in Rs1.69 billion Malaysia fee racket
results.content: Police say Nepali workers were charged an unauthorised 100-ringgit each, with 90 percent of the proceeds transferred to Malaysia through Nepal Rastra Bank.

results.title: Nepal's investment reforms yet to restore business confidence
results.content: Business leaders say policy uncertainty, bureaucratic hurdles, local taxes and poor infrastructure continue to deter investment despite government pledges to improve the business climate.

results.title: India calls Shah’s visit ‘very important’, promises full state honours
results.content: Kathmandu and New Delhi are still negotiating the key agenda items, possible deliverables and outcomes of the visit, as well as the contents of the joint communiqué and joint vision paper to be issued at its conclusion.

results.title: Nepali rock gets its moment on the world stage
results.content: At 26, Bhojpur-born singer Pratik Himal Rai represented Nepal at Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok, and won over audiences even as he finished ninth.

results.title: The NPL has found its fans. Now it must go to them.
results.content: If Nepal’s franchise cricket league wants to represent the whole country, it must stop playing every match in Kathmandu.

results.title: Nepal’s conflict victims still await justice 20 years after peace deal
results.content: The International Commission of Jurists says thousands of survivors and families remain without truth, accountability or reparations, urging the government to revive the stalled transitional justice process.

results.title: Nepal begin Rising Stars campaign against formidable India A
results.content: Tilak Varma praises Nepal’s progress, but Sandeep Lamichhane’s side face a formidable Indian team packed with international and IPL experience
